about: The words Android says differently from the iOS String Catalogs, and why. scripts/android-words.py puts each in place of the catalog's words in Android's strings.xml and core's words.json, and fails for a key no catalog has any more. Each entry: the catalog's book (app, shared, widgets), the iOS key as the catalog has it, Android's words in the catalog's own specifiers (%@, %lld; for a plural key, its one, few and other forms), and why. Keep it short: a word belongs here only when Android truly can't say what iOS says.

words.key: Codul rămâne ascuns. Îl vezi după Face ID, din pagina actului.
words.android: Codul rămâne ascuns. Îl vezi după deblocarea telefonului, din pagina actului.
words.why: Android unlocks with the fingerprint, the face or the phone's PIN, and has no Face ID: „deblocarea telefonului” covers all three (the owner's choice, 26 November 2026).
